title: Prophet (Vampire)
description: Lord Harkon commands the court to find a Moth Priest who can read Serana's Elder Scroll and reveal the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy. The trail leads through Solitude and Dragon Bridge to Forebears' Holdout, where rival vampires have captured the priest. After enthralling Dexion Evicus with Vampire's Seduction, the player returns to Castle Volkihar to hear the prophecy's first vision of Auriel's Bow.

base_facts: I am the lord of Castle Volkihar and leader of the Volkihar vampires.
I seek to fulfill the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy to end the sun's dominion over vampires.
I have spread false rumors about an Elder Scroll in Skyrim to lure a Moth Priest here.

HARKON_SPEECH: I have proclaimed to the court that a Moth Priest must be found to read Serana's Elder Scroll.
RETURN_AND_READ: The Moth Priest has been captured and brought to Castle Volkihar. Now the prophecy can be read.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Moth Priest's reading revealed only a vision of Auriel's Bow; the full Tyranny of the Sun prophecy cannot be unraveled without two more Elder Scrolls.
The partial reading has left more questions than answers about how to fulfill the prophecy and end the sun's dominion.
The enthralled Moth Priest Dexion Evicus remains at Castle Volkihar, available for future Elder Scroll readings once the remaining scrolls are recovered.
Two new pursuits now follow: Chasing Echoes and Seeking Disclosure, to locate the remaining Elder Scrolls needed to complete the prophecy.

base_facts: I am Lord Harkon's daughter, recently freed from centuries of entombment.
I possess an Elder Scroll that may contain a prophecy about the sun.

SEARCH_FOR_PRIEST: I suggested the College of Winterhold as a place to find information about the Moth Priest.
I asked to accompany the player on the search for the Moth Priest.

base_facts: I am a senior vampire of the Volkihar court.
I directed the player to speak with Lord Harkon after the previous quest.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Harkon and listens to his proclamation about finding a Moth Priest to read the Elder Scroll.
Player searches for the Moth Priest by asking innkeepers, carriage drivers, or visiting the College of Winterhold. Trail leads to Dragon Bridge.
Player investigates the attacked carriage, reads the Vampire's Note, and enters Forebears' Holdout to find the captured Moth Priest.
Player defeats the enthralled Moth Priest, uses Vampire's Seduction to enthrall him, and commands him to go to Castle Volkihar.
Player reports success to Harkon and commands Dexion to read the Elder Scroll, revealing a vision of Auriel's Bow.
The Moth Priest's reading reveals Auriel's Bow but two more Elder Scrolls are needed. Quest finishes.
